hypothesis: A context-aware evidence schema improves identification of contradictions and context-specific findings versus an unstructured summary
why_it_matters: Could make literature synthesis more reproducible
proposed_test: Blind comparison by independent reviewers using the same paper set
disconfirming_result: No improvement in accuracy or reviewer utility

hypothesis: Combining distinct cardiac disease contexts can obscure context-specific mechanisms
proposed_test: Stratify findings by disease context and compare with pooled synthesis
disconfirming_result: No meaningful context-dependent differences in the reviewed evidence

hypothesis: Separating fibroblast populations and states changes interpretation of candidate mechanisms
why_it_matters: Cell-state heterogeneity may matter for interpretation
proposed_test: Compare cell-state-resolved and broad fibroblast-level summaries
disconfirming_result: No change in interpretation or prioritization

hypothesis: Some antifibrotic signals depend on preclinical or surrogate endpoints without established patient-important benefit
proposed_test: Map evidence maturity and endpoint type across the selected literature
disconfirming_result: Most relevant claims already have robust clinical outcome evidence

hypothesis: Specific biological transport principles may inspire delivery strategies with measurable advantages over existing systems
why_it_matters: Could identify a differentiated engineering question
proposed_test: Compare a narrowly defined principle against existing delivery approaches and patents
disconfirming_result: No distinct advantage or prior art already covers the concept
